spec_match.rationale: Calls the exact proposed performance.getSpeculations() instance method and documents the explainer's return shape (preconnects, preloads with used timestamps, navigations with type/tags/eagerness, navigationDestinationURL), shipping two real preload links so an enabled build has data to report.

interactive.rationale: A live typeof probe, a call button that invokes the real method and pretty-prints whatever it returns, and a visually-distinct dashed reference panel explicitly tagged 'reference — not a live result'.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a button calling the real method, field-by-field printing, and a capability probe that can return false; all present, with the probe honestly reading undefined here.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers method-absent (honest fallback text, no fabricated result), a throwing call, and empty-result objects; the banner gives the exact blink flag and origin-trial path.

references.rationale: See-also cites https://chromestatus.com/feature/5118840377835520 plus all three sibling concepts.

conformance.rationale: The feature suite checks the instance-method placement, rejects the stale property form, and validates the return shape; its 3 pass / 4 fail in this Chromium 141 session reflects only the expected absent experimental method.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 CLI/CDP (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): DOM shows the probe honestly reading 'undefined ✗ (enable the experiment)' with the reference shape rendered; zero console errors, no unintended failed requests; the call button could not be clicked non-interactively.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the probe result, the unavailable branch, live reads with returned keys, and thrown calls.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only, the default-visible unavailable state uses --accent-rose (≈5.3:1, AA-clean), the reference panel is visually distinct without relying on colour, and buttons follow the colour-override rule.

accessibility.rationale: The live result is aria-live, the reference is labelled by visible text tags, and the single control is a native focus-visible button.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: CDP-emulated 360×740 DPR3 measures 0px horizontal overflow (JSON panes wrap and scroll internally); desktop 1280×800 clean; only the environmental Google Fonts request fails.

openQuestions.title: Capture a live getSpeculations() read in a SpeculationMeasurement-enabled build
openQuestions.detail: This Chromium 141 lacks the experiment, so only the honest-unavailable branch was observed. In a Chrome build with --enable-blink-features=SpeculationMeasurement (or the origin trial), press the call button and record the real preloads array including this page's two shipped preload links, verifying the reference shape matches what the implementation actually returns.

summary: A clean core-surface inspector: real method invocation, an honest can-return-false probe, and a reference shape that is impossible to mistake for live data. Verified with headless Chromium 141 via CLI/CDP (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable in this environment): truthful unavailable state, clean console, no unintended failed requests, no overflow on either device class. Only remaining work is recording a flagged-build live read.
